iWantTo: see a scannable table of stock by location showing SKU, location, and quantity
soThat: I can quickly check what is on each shelf

independence.rationale: Story 1 builds the write path and stores records; Story 2 builds the read path and the home screen view that displays all stock. The observable outcomes are distinct: write -> confirmation, read -> rendered table. Building S1 fully does not deliver the home table view that S2 adds.
